pages.title: Datapack Overrides
pages.text: Nourished uses a $(bold)three-layer override system$():$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Bundled defaults$() — curated food classifications that ship with the mod$(li)$(thing)Config$() — server owners tune any mechanic$(li)$(thing)Datapacks$() — $(bold)always win.$() Full control over food classifications.$(br2)Datapacks can reclassify any food, add unknowns, or remove foods from a group entirely.

pages.title: Integration
pages.text: $(italic)No code forks. No mixins. No hard dependencies.$()$(br2)Integrating with Nourished via datapacks requires nothing beyond the datapack itself.$(br2)For mod developers integrating via Java, Nourished exposes a stable public API.$(br2)See the $(thing)Nourished documentation on GitHub$() for full details.
